help.title: How do I use Tara?
help.lede: Give Tara your game recordings and a little context. The application handles transcription and delivers a summary ready for review.
help.quick_body: Once analysis starts, there is nothing else to do: simply keep the private link so you can return for the result.
help.step_audio_body: Select one track per person, or a multitrack ZIP archive.
help.step_context_body: Introduce the campaign, characters, and any established facts.
help.step_wait_body: Tara uploads, transcribes, analyses, and verifies the session.
help.step_result_body: Read it in Tara or download the Markdown file.
help.craig_body: Craig is a multitrack Discord recording bot: every person gets a separate track, which helps Tara know who is speaking.
help.craig_record_body: After informing the participants, invite Craig into the voice channel with /join. At the end of the game, use /stop.
help.craig_download_body: Open the download link sent by Craig and save the ZIP containing one audio track per person.
help.craig_import_body: On the New analysis page, drop the Craig ZIP file: Tara automatically recognizes the archive, then lets you check the name assigned to each track.
help.craig_tip: There is no need to extract the archive: Tara accepts the Craig ZIP directly.
help.context_body: A few simple reference points are enough. They prevent name mix-ups and make the summary more faithful to your campaign.
help.context_game: The game system and campaign name
help.context_people: The game master’s name and the mapping between players and characters
help.context_campaign: Important locations, factions, or stakes at the start of the session
help.context_previous: Previous session summaries, if you have them
help.inputs_body: Tara accepts MP3, OGG, AAC or M4A tracks, an audio ZIP archive — including Craig’s — or a merged YAML transcription when those modes are offered on the home screen.
help.link_body: The full link is a bearer owner capability: anyone who has it controls the job. The fragment after # is not sent in request URLs, but remains visible in browser history, the clipboard, screenshots, screen sharing, and to some extensions. Treat it like a password and rotate it if exposed.
help.resume_body: You may close the page during upload or analysis. Return with the same link and select the requested file again to resume from the confirmed byte.
help.status_body: The page shows queueing, active stages, attempts, and recoverable errors. If the realtime stream is unavailable, Tara automatically falls back to periodic checks.
help.retention_body: Policy currently applied by this instance:
help.retention_session_body: A session with no declared file expires after 30 minutes. The first declaration reserves active capacity; files remain available for up to 24 hours while the session is pending, then are deleted as soon as its job finishes or is abandoned.
help.retention_work_label: Sources and working files · until the job ends
help.retention_work_body: Source files, general context, previous summaries, raw transcription, and every other intermediate file are deleted after success, failure, timeout, or cancellation. Relaunching then requires new input files.
help.retention_result_body: The final Markdown summary remains available for 7 days after it is generated. Its exact expiry date and time are shown on the result page.
help.retention_delete_body: The job becomes inaccessible immediately. Private sources and working files are removed at the terminal transition; any retained final result is removed by automatic cleanup.
help.retention_database_label: Database tracking records · no automatic purge yet
help.retention_database_body: After expiry, Tara currently retains session and job tracking records: identifiers, the non-reversible fingerprint of the private link, statuses, dates, metrics, file names, and associated people. General context and previous summaries are cleared when the job ends.
help.retention_cleanup_note: Cleanup is attempted immediately when a job ends and retried at startup and every hour after an interruption. Always download or copy the final result before the displayed date.
help.privacy_body: Only add necessary content. Public errors and technical logs do not include your text, secrets, or internal paths.
